purpose: Teach: 授与/保健所/延命/即答/一辺倒/疲弊/病名/早けれ

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、感謝状の授与をいたしました
lines.en: We've presented a commendation from the police.
lines.style: Formal, measured cadence. Clear enunciation on the verb phrase. Professional pride held steady — not cold, but official. Even breath throughout.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察と保健所、連携ありがたいです
lines.en: Yes. We're grateful for the cooperation between the police and health department.
lines.style: Respectful, slightly formal. Acknowledging tone — not obsequious, but sincere gratitude. Straightforward rhythm. The gratitude genuine and specific.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、被害者の延命措置にも協力しました
lines.en: The police also cooperated in extending the victim's life.
lines.style: Steady, factual delivery. No drama on the serious content. Professional composure. Matter-of-fact pace, as if reporting one fact among many of equal weight.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察の即答力、頼もしいです
lines.en: Yes. The police's quick response has been reassuring.
lines.style: Warm appreciation beneath the formal surface. Slight lean forward on 'quick response' — genuine respect. Quieter than before, more personal.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、捜査一辺倒ではなく予防にも力を入れます
lines.en: The police don't focus solely on investigation — we're also investing in prevention.
lines.style: Measured, deliberate pacing. Slight emphasis on the shift from 'investigation' to 'prevention' — presenting a philosophy shift. Calm authority. Breath steady and clear.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察官、疲弊しない勤務体制ありがたいです
lines.en: Yes. We're grateful for the working conditions that don't exhaust our officers.
lines.style: Sincere, thoughtful — this reflects personal care. Quiet warmth. The gratitude for welfare, not just efficiency. Slight slowness on 'don't exhaust' — it matters.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、感染症の病名公表に協力します
lines.en: The police will cooperate in disclosing the name of the infectious disease.
lines.style: Clear procedural statement. No hesitation. Professional distance. Even pace. The responsibility stated plainly — important and handled.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。早ければ年内に新警察署が完成しますね
lines.en: Yes. The new police station should be complete by the end of the year.
lines.style: Warm, almost conversational now. Forward-looking — a note of hope. Slightly lighter rhythm. The close of the exchange — a look toward the future together.
